verdict.rationale: Elicit's own Alerts fire automatically when a new relevant paper is found, sending instant email notifications. A single line says Routines can act on what they find: filter on custom criteria, update an artifact, or write a summary. That points to native event-driven actions, but Routines get only one glancing mention, with no detail on how rules or triggers are defined. missing for 10: documentation of how Routine rules and triggers are configured, the range of trigger events beyond new papers, the available action types, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
